# Tend

> Tend is a calm life-maintenance app for remembering recurring care without a task-manager workflow.

## Public Pages

- https://tend.qzz.io/
- https://tend.qzz.io/privacy
- https://tend.qzz.io/terms

## App

- https://app.tend.qzz.io/ is the authenticated Tend web app.
- The app is invite-only during pre-alpha.
- Authenticated app routes and `/api/` endpoints are not public documentation surfaces.

## Product Notes

- Tend tracks recurring household care, health upkeep, relationships, pets, vehicles, life admin, routines, and similar real-life maintenance.
- Tend uses gentle status language: Fresh, Getting stale, and Needs attention.
- Tend avoids guilt-driven language such as overdue, late, streaks, points, and alarm-style productivity mechanics.
